notes: Read SKILL.md in full. The skill compares vector databases and covers Qdrant deployment, collection and payload-index management, filtered search, pgvector schema and indexes, Weaviate compose with API-key auth, snapshot/pg_dump backup and restore, and performance tuning.

Following it can make the agent start Docker containers, create collections and indexes, run snapshot/restore via the Qdrant REST API, and run pg_dump/pg_restore against the user's databases (SKILL.md:226-241). These operate on databases the user is setting up and include no deletes; the skill advises snapshotting before bulk deletes (SKILL.md:279). Medium risk because restores overwrite data and should be confirmed with the user.

The Qdrant 'Production Deployment' docker run (SKILL.md:35-50) publishes ports 6333/6334 with no API key and uses the :latest tag, and pgvector uses POSTGRES_PASSWORD=secret on a published port; users should add a Qdrant API key, pin images, and use real secrets before production. Related-skill links (../../local-ai/rag-infrastructure/, ../, ../postgresql/ at SKILL.md:283-285) are optional pointers.
